sentences.text:
Panarva, Dist. Udaipur (At Present Lodged In Central Jail,
Udaipur)

----Petitioner  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through PP.
2.
Sona Devi W/o Shankar Lal Taral, resident of Khokhra, Police Station Panarva, District Udaipur.
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Love Jain.
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mukhtiyar Khan, PP.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 19/10/2023

This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.76/2023 registered at Police Station Panarva, District Udaipur, for offences under Sections 450, 376 and 506 IPC.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case.

Learned counsel submitted that the FIR has been lodged by the prosecutrix against the present petitioner on 01.06.2023 for an alleged act of sexual assault committed upon her by the present petitioner on 17.10.2022.

Learned counsel submitted that the FIR has been [2023:RJ-JD:35904] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-11200/2023] filed by the prosecutrix after a delay of about 8 months from the date of the alleged incident, without furnishing any plausible explanation for the same.

Drawing attention of the Court towards the FIR, learned counsel submitted that it is highly improbable that the prosecutrix could be subjected to sexual assault by the present petitioner in her own house, particularly when her husband was sleeping outside the house with their children.

Lastly, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is in judicial custody;
investigation against him has already been completed; challan has been filed before the competent criminal court, therefore, no fruitful purpose would be served by keeping him behind the bars for an indefinite period.
The trial of the case is likely to consume sufficiently long time.
On these grounds, he implored the Court to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor vehemently opposed the bail application.

Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, this Court prima facie finds that no satisfactory explanation has been furnished by the prosecutrix who is a mature married woman, for lodging the FIR after a delay of 8 months from the date of the alleged incident.
This Court also prima facie finds that the prosecution has not expressed any apprehension of the prosecutrix being influenced by the present petitioner.

[2023:RJ-JD:35904] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-11200/2023] In view of aforesaid and the fact that challan has been filed and the trial of the case is likely to consume sufficiently long time, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Shankar S/o Babu Lal arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.76/2023 registered at Police Station Panarva, District Udaipur, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case,
provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 78-Tikam/-
